🗣 Luciano #Spalletti to 'Sky Sport': "An avoidable goal from a corner? They had rightly prepared that situation and they delivered it right there, they saw that we were uncovered in that zone. Those who make up the zonal setup in front of the penalty area need to understand where to shift. That is where you build your fortress: if there are no opponents, you have to move it. If the jumpers go to the back post, the zone has to slide over there too. Interpretation is important. I was saying: 'They are here, go to the back, to the back'. #Bremer And #DeGea Save #JuveLucio mounts a comeback in Florence: 2-2#Pellegrino opens the score. Equalizer by #Woltemade. Then #Njie's flash of brilliance. The Brazilian capitalizes on a mistake by #David.[Front Page Corriere dello Sport]

PRIDE, ANGER AND #VICARIO#Fiorentina-#Juve 2-2Double comeback at the Franchi with a great #Kolo and #Bremer. Glimpses of a beautiful play but a fragile defense and a clear penalty denied.The goalkeeper saves twice to rescue a draw that could have been the 3rd win in a row, if the referee had punished the handball in the penalty area by the bianconero loanee #JoaoMario. Scoring for the Viola were #Pellegrino, who was snatched away from #Carnevali, and the ex granata #Njie following #Woltemade's goal. #Spalletti jokes about the penalty not given but admits: "We completely drown in a glass of water". #Gatti called up to the Nazionale.[Front Page TuttoSport]

🗣 Luciano #Spalletti to 'Sky Sport': "#KoloMuani's performance? Now he has a different conviction and a different way of interpreting things. Whether as a winger or a central forward, if he starts dropping deep to receive the ball, chasing down an opponent all the way back to our penalty area, winning a tackle and restarting from there, everything changes. In the first few matches, he started playing as a hold-up target man and seemed to have lost his qualities. We signed him precisely for this, for the qualities he has. But, if he can't display them from a physical and mental standpoint, then one might feel like moving him a meter this way or a meter that way. Now the brace on his hand has

🗣 Luciano #Spalletti to 'Sky Sport': "What do I take home from tonight? The performance or the anger over those avoidable goals? You take everything home, because that is the flow of the match. Clearly, I would like to improve that specific thing over there not to happen. However, by now it has happened to us several times that we fail to be our best individually and, consequently, as a team as well. Because in the very same match we commit errors that are far too trivial , yet we make the burst of play that can secure us the advantage, the goal. But we don't close it out, because the ball goes through there so much. Therefore, there is a bit to improve in several areas".[@juventusinsidernew

🗣 Luciano #Spalletti in the press conference: "Did I fear I had lost the locker room? These are things that are part of the talking points people put on display. What lose them. I embrace my boys every single day, I talk to them. The directors are always there watching us, checking on us. I am looking for the solution to do better and we are close to it because tonight we played a part of the match incredibly well. We just lack consistency over the 90 minutes considering the quality we possess".[@juventusinsidernews]

🗣 Luciano #Spalletti in the press conference: "Worried about the standings? You always tell us that we are out of Europe, that we have to win the league and the Europa League. It's understood, I know why I'm here and that I have to do well".[@juventusinsidernews]

🗣 Luciano #Spalletti in the press conference: "Am I happy with #KoloMuani's performance? Now we have the #KoloMuani we wanted to have and his position doesn't matter because when he decides to do things with power and with the running qualify he possesses, you can put him anywhere. He can play as a striker, a winger, but until now he had performed at a slightly lower level".[@juventusinsidernews]

🗣 Luciano #Spalletti in the press conference: "Do I have any regrets or am I satisfied? I am not completely happy because we don't express a consistent level of football worthy of aspiring to something important. There are moments when we are locked in, then at a certain point we let go, we lose possession on balls that are easy to read, we lose our balance. Then we could have even won the match, we had the chances to do so. We have this alternating pattern that prevents me from being happy. Because the team did show desire, and so did #Fiorentina. It was a match of who could hit the other harder, but then we lack consistency".[@juventusinsidernews]

🗣 Luciano #Spalletti to 'DAZN': "Was that a penalty on #JoaoMario? I don't know, because I don't know... Can I have a backup question instead? I don't need to see it, I already saw it on the pitch".[@juventusinsidernews]

🗣 Luciano #Spalletti to 'DAZN': "Two forwards? The choice was dictated by the fact that they come out to aggressively press you and we don't have a great buildup from the back, so we have to go direct to the forwards. Even though this isn't #Woltemade's primary strength - since he struggles to hold up the ball afterward - he is much more about combination play and shielding the ball with the team. #KoloMuani is doing a bit better now, with this rediscovered form, you can put him anywhere and he brings home a solid performance".[@juventusinsidernews]

🗣 Luciano #Spalletti to 'DAZN': "What is missing? In certain moments, the decision is made to do nothing and just stand there accepting the situation without going out to make a choice and react, because it's the choice that removes any doubt that you are carrying. Those who hesitate almost never manage to bring anything home".[@juventusinsidernews]

🗣 Luciano #Spalletti to 'DAZN': "Match analysis? Every now and then we completely drown in a glass of water from head to toe and we lose some of our confidence and calmness to play. We conceded a goal early without communicating the shifting of the defensive line. Afterward, we had some good reactions, but we fail to be consistent, even in terms of individual performance. We do one thing well for ten minutes, and then we lack something else...".[@juventusinsidernews]
📊😬 #Spalletti's #Juventus is the second worst after the 11th matchday of the last 8 years, only behind #Allegri's 2021-22.[@DAZN_IT via @PuebloJ]

🎙Randal #KoloMuani on @DAZN_IT:FINAL FEELING"Clearly, I am not happy.We knew that today wouldn't be easy, this match closed a small cycle.We have to keep working hard to get the results."WINGER POSITION"If I play, I am happy, it doesn't matter if it's on the right or on the left.It's clear that when I have space to attack, I manage to make the most of my qualities."OBJECTIVE"We have the international break to work hard.We have had too many draws and defeats, we are certainly falling behind, but we want to make sure we are ready for the return."[@PuebloJ]
